priorities.summary: A prompt-template sandbox escape in GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets an authenticated user with custom-flow privileges execute arbitrary commands on the self-hosted AI Gateway, exposing JWT signing keys and model-provider channels. Patch to 19.2.4, 19.3.2 or 19.4.1 immediately.

An authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager lets an unauthenticated remote attacker gain administrative API access through improper URI encoding handling. Cisco confirms exploitation was observed in September; patch regardless of configuration.

A path traversal in Fortinet FortiMail allows an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files to the system via crafted HTTP(S) requests. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 1 — verify vendor patch availability now.

model.name: Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk")
model.summary: Mistral's biggest model yet: a 1.05-trillion-parameter natively multimodal MoE with 49B active params, 1M-token context and frontier-tier cyber/coding scores. Available via API preview now; open weights land October 27 after red-teaming with governments and cybersecurity partners.
